```{r, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse) #for manipulating data
library(here) #for setting reproducible working directory
library(cowplot) #for combining plot panels
```

```{r include = FALSE}
# Import data
data_predator <- read_csv(here("data", "VanScoyoc_et_al_data.csv"), trim_ws = TRUE) %>% 
                 mutate(ID = paste0(reference, predator_common), #add unique ID
                        trophic_position = "Predator",
                        diurnal_shift = pr_high_D_AR - pr_low_D_AR) %>% #calculate activity shift
                 dplyr::select(ID, reference, trophic_position, diurnal_shift,
                               predator_guild,predator_hunting_mode,
                               trophic_level = predator_trophic_level, 
                               body_mass = predator_mass_category,
                               circadian_rhythm = predator_circadian_rhythm) %>% 
                 unique() #remove duplicate predators

data_prey <- read_csv(here("data", "VanScoyoc_et_al_data.csv"), trim_ws = TRUE) %>% 
                 mutate(ID = paste0(reference, prey_common), #add unique ID
                        trophic_position = "Prey",
                        diurnal_shift = py_high_D_AR - py_low_D_AR) %>% #calculate activity shift
                 dplyr::select(ID, reference, trophic_position, diurnal_shift,
                               prey_order, body_mass = prey_mass_category, 
                               trophic_level = prey_trophic_level, 
                               circadian_rhythm = prey_circadian_rhythm) %>% 
                 unique() #remove duplicate prey

data <- full_join(data_predator, data_prey) #49 predators, 76 prey
```

```{r}
#calculate median values, standard deviation, and sample size for each functional trait 

trophic_position <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = trophic_position) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Trophic position")

bodysize <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = body_mass, trophic_position) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Body size (kg)")

trophic_level <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = trophic_level, trophic_position) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Trophic level")

circadian_rhythm <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = circadian_rhythm, trophic_position) %>% 
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Circadian rhythm")

hunting_mode <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = predator_hunting_mode) %>% 
                drop_na(type) %>% #drop prey values
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Hunting mode")

predator_guild <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = predator_guild) %>% 
                drop_na(type) %>% #drop prey values
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Predator guild")

prey_order <- data %>% 
                group_by(type = prey_order) %>% 
                drop_na(type) %>% #drop predator values
                summarise(med_val = median(diurnal_shift), 
                          sd = sd(diurnal_shift), n = n()) %>% 
                mutate(group = "Prey order")
```

```{r}
#calculate confidence intervals and order variables for plotting

functional_traits <- rbind(trophic_position, predator_guild, hunting_mode, prey_order) %>% 
                     mutate(ci_low = med_val - sd, 
                            ci_high = med_val + sd,
                            group = factor(group, levels = c("Trophic position", "Predator guild", 
                                                             "Hunting mode", "Prey order")),
                            type = factor(type, levels = c("Prey", "Predator", 
                                                           "Mesocarnivore","Apex", 
                                                           "Other", "Ungulate", "Rodent",
                                                           "Primate","Lagomorph", "Marsupial",
                                                           "Opportunistic","Cursorial", "Ambush")))

functional_traits2 <- rbind(trophic_level, bodysize, circadian_rhythm) %>% 
                     mutate(ci_low = med_val - sd, 
                            ci_high = med_val + sd,
                            group = factor(group, levels = c("Trophic level","Body size (kg)", 
                                                             "Circadian rhythm")),
                            type = factor(type, levels = c("Herbivore","Omnivore", "Carnivore",
                                                           "> 100 kg","50-100 kg", "10-50 kg","< 10 kg",                                                                     "Nocturnal","Crepuscular","Diurnal")))
```




```{r}
#create plot panel without colors

fig_S1a <- ggplot(functional_traits, aes(y = type, x = med_val, xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high)) +
            geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="grey60",linetype="dashed") +
            geom_point(color = "grey40") +
            geom_errorbarh(height = .1,color = "grey40") +
            scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1),breaks=c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,.5,1))+
            facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
            theme_bw() +
            xlab("Median Change in Diurnality") +
            ylab("") +
            theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
                  text=element_text(size=10, family="serif"), 
                    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
            geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, label = paste0("n = ", n)), family = "serif", size = 2.5, hjust = 0)
```

```{r}
#create plot panel with colors

fig_S1b <- ggplot(functional_traits2, aes(y = type, x = med_val, 
                                          xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high, color = as.factor(trophic_position))) +
              geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="grey60",linetype="dashed") +
              geom_point(position=position_dodge(width= -.5)) +
              geom_errorbarh(height = .1, position=position_dodge(width=-.5)) +
              scale_color_manual(values = c("Predator" = "#FFC30B","Prey" = "#87CBBB")) +
              scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1),breaks=c(-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,.5,1))+
              facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
              theme_bw() +
              xlab("Median Change in Diurnality") +
              ylab("") +
              theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
                    text=element_text(size=10, family="serif"), 
                    legend.title = element_blank(), 
                    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = "#3D3D3D"), 
                    legend.position = "bottom", 
                    legend.margin= margin(1,1,1,1), 
                    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = "transparent"), 
                    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
              geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, label = paste0("n = ", n)), position = position_dodge(width = -.7), 
                        family = "serif", size = 2.5, hjust = 0)
```

```{r fig2, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 6.5, dpi = 300}
# Plot both figures
fig_S1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(fig_S1a, fig_S1b)
fig_S1
#ggsave("figure_S1.png", figure2, height = 4, width = 6.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
**Fig. S1.** *The influence of functional traits on the difference in percent diurnal activity for terrestrial mammal predators and prey between sites of high and low human use (n = 49 predators, n = 76 prey, 19 studies).*
